'''Mercè Durfort i Coll''' (4 April 1943 – 7 April 2022) was a Spanish biologist and professor. She was a member of [[Institute for Catalan Studies]] from 1989 until her death.<ref>[https://www.racab.cat/noticies/2022/2022-abr-11 Mor l'acadèmica Mercè Durfort i Coll (1943-2022)] {{in lang|ca}}</ref>
